# Synthetic document fixtures

These files contain only synthetic local test text. `word.docx` was generated with python-docx, `workbook.xlsx` with openpyxl, `slides.pptx` with python-pptx, and `pages.pdf` with reportlab. No runtime extraction uses Python. They exercise actual Office packaging, relationships, headers/tables, named worksheets/inline strings/formulas, slide order, and PDF page text. Formula caches are not generated by openpyxl, so extraction must explicitly report missing cached values rather than execute the formula. All other malicious/limit fixtures are generated inside isolated test directories.
